description: Watch the crypto market for 24 hours: up to 10 conditions (price, % change, funding, open interest, liquidations, order book, Fear and Greed, whale orders, news impact) checked every minute; when one happens, a signed webhook goes to callback_url and it shows in watch_status. Level conditions fire when they turn true. Keep the returned secret (USD 0.02).

op.description: above: >= value; below: <= value (events use above)

token.description: Ticker such as BTC; "*" (any coin) for whale_order_usd and news_impact; omit for fear_greed

value.description: Threshold in the metric's unit: percent for *_pct, USD for *_usd

name: create_watch
